title: fix(console): every console form entry point renders the form view's buttons, layout and defaults, and a tabbed form with subforms opens on its defaultTab
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ83Xfyz6um6gNWtmJ2QTcNH3)_
Refs #26843 (items buttons, layout, defaults, defaultTab, tabPosition)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — the skills and docs already teach these keys as rendered (`content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` for `defaultTab` / `tabPosition`, the spec's property help for `buttons` / `defaults` / `layout`); this diff makes the console do what they say.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台三个表单入口（整页新建/编辑、新建/编辑弹窗、表单页 `/forms/:name` 与公开表单 `/f/:slug`）现在都按表单视图里声明的 `buttons`、`layout`、`defaults` 渲染；带子表的分页签表单按 `defaultTab` / `tabPosition` 打开。
- 为什么改：这些键能保存、能发布，但各入口用自己写死的 `showSubmit: true`、按钮文案和 `layout: 'vertical'` 盖掉了作者的值，作者看不到任何效果（ADR-0049 声明即生效）。
- 风险与回滚：只改 UI 渲染层，不动 spec 和服务端；表单视图没写这些键时行为不变（每组测试都有对照用例）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts`（`resolveFormViewChrome` 的优先级与 `defaults` 合并缓存）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`（新建弹窗那一处）、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx`（子表分支补 `formType`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/formViewChrome-26843.test.ts packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/formViewTabKeysAndButtons-26843.test.tsx`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One resolver, `resolveFormViewChrome` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordFormNavigation.ts`), maps the selected form view's keys onto the form props, and the full-page record form and the New / Edit dialog both spread it in place of their hard-coded sets:

- `buttons.submit` / `buttons.cancel`: an authored `show` wins over the host's `true`; an authored `label` (an `I18nLabel`, resolved against the UI language) over the host's label. `buttons.reset` is not read: no host draws a reset button.
- `layout`: the authored value when the spec's enum allows it, else `'vertical'`.
- `defaults`, on a create only: merged under the values the host already carries (URL prefill on the page; the `formLink` pre-link or the opener's seeded values in the dialog), which win per field. Before, any prefill dropped `defaults` wholesale, and the dialog never read them. The merged seed is cached on the metadata payload and on the host values by content, so it keeps its identity across renders (the forms re-seed on a new `initialValues`), with no dependency on a memoised identity (ui/AGENTS.md #10).

Precedence, as measured: no flat `showSubmit` / `submitText` / `showCancel` / `cancelText` key is author-written. `FormViewSchema` is strict and refuses them, and a census over `examples/**` and `packages/**` finds the one `submitText` on a page block (`project-workspace.page.ts`, an `object-master-detail-form` node), none on a form view. So the hosts' flat values are console defaults, and the authored form-view keys win.

The form page (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`) is its own renderer and reads the same keys locally: `readFormButton` for the submit / cancel label and visibility (the public route still draws no Cancel), and `readPrefill` takes the form view's `defaults` on a create, over the object's field defaults and under a `?prefill_` param.

The tab keys:

- `resolveFormViewLayout` copies `defaultTab` / `tabPosition` beside `contentLayout: 'tabbed'`, and `ModalForm`'s tabbed arm hands them to the form renderer (`defaultFieldTab` / `fieldTabsPosition`).
- `ModalForm`'s subforms arm now passes `formType` (tabbed when the content layout is), the tab keys, `layout` and `showSubmit` to `MasterDetailForm`, and hands `onCancel` only when Cancel is shown.
- `ObjectForm`'s master-detail branch forwards `defaultTab` / `tabPosition` / `layout`, and `onCancel` only when `showCancel` is not `false`; `MasterDetailForm` passes the three keys to its header `ObjectForm`.

Not in this PR (the seat's split): `buttons.reset` and the drawer keys (`drawerSide` / `drawerWidth`), which stay on #26843 for an implement-or-retire spec card.

## Tests

New, each block with a CONTROL where the key is absent:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/formViewChrome-26843.test.ts`: the resolver's precedence, the per-locale label, the refused `layout: 'grid'` and `tabPosition` values, the per-field merge and its identity, edit reads no defaults.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.formViewChrome-26843.test.tsx`: the page hands the authored chrome to `ObjectForm`; a URL prefill wins per field.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.formViewChrome-26843.test.tsx`: the dialog hands the authored chrome and tab keys to `ModalForm`; a `formLink` pre-link wins per field and the seed has one identity across renders; the real dialog draws the authored label and no Cancel.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/formViewTabKeysAndButtons-26843.test.tsx`: real renders. A tabbed form with subforms opens on `defaultTab` with a vertical strip for `tabPosition: 'left'`; the modal tabbed arm and its subforms arm likewise; master-detail Cancel and Save follow `showCancel` / `showSubmit`.
- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.formViewChrome-26843.test.tsx`: authored labels and hidden buttons on the internal and public routes, `defaults` on a create, a `prefill_` param wins, an edit reads the record.

## Acceptance notes

- `layout: 'horizontal'` now reaches every form the console opens, but the shared form renderer's only reading of it is the action row's alignment (`sm:justify-end` against `sm:justify-start`). The dialog draws its buttons in its own footer, which is always end-aligned, and the form page's action row is always end-aligned too. So in those two places the key arrives and nothing is drawn differently. What `horizontal` should draw (labels beside inputs, as the spec's "Field layout direction" reads) is a renderer-contract question for the seat; it is listed in the report.
- `TabbedForm` hard-codes `layout: 'vertical'` on the form it builds, so `horizontal` on a tabbed form view is dropped there. The file is outside this card's surface; it is listed in the report.
- A master-detail form with `showSubmit: false` hides its whole action bar, Cancel included, as before.
- `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` rows for `buttons` and `defaults` cite `RecordFormPage` as forwarding them; it forwarded them, but then set its own flat keys over `buttons`, and the New dialog and the form page read neither. The ledger is not edited here (`packages/spec/**` is out of bounds); the stale evidence is listed in the report.
